environment.description: EKS 1.28 pod running in namespace 'services' with default pod security standard (privileged). Container runs as root (UID 0). Pod spec includes shareProcessNamespace: true allowing sidecar containers to send signals to the gRPC process. No PodDisruptionBudget configured. The /tmp directory is a shared emptyDir volume mounted across the main container and the drain-helper sidecar. Service account has cluster-admin ClusterRoleBinding. No seccomp profile applied. No network policy restricting pod-to-pod communication.
